categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies core utility header src/span.h to add compile-time lifetime annotations to span helper functions.
categories.rationale: Adds Clang lifetimebound annotations to span utility functions to prevent use-after-free bugs from temporary containers. Per the description, annotating MakeByteSpan and MakeUCharSpan allows diagnosing dangling views at compile time, providing a worthwhile preventive safety enhancement across shared primitives without addressing an active runtime defect.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touch to src/dbwrapper.cpp is merely a std::ranges::enable_borrowed_range trait specialization for leveldb::Slice to avoid false-positive compiler diagnostics.
categories.rationale: Does not substantively alter validation rules, database invariants, or chainstate behavior. The mechanical edit in src/dbwrapper.cpp merely follows from the lifetimebound annotations in src/span.h.
